name: aXcelerate LMS
summary: An Australian training management platform combining LMS, student management and RTO administration, with learning plans, assessment and compliance workflows.

accessibility.finding: No product-specific ACR/VPAT found; request current web app and mobile app reports.
accessibility.caveat: Public site focuses on security and platform features, not accessibility evidence.

security.finding: aXcelerate Enterprise LMS page claims ISO 27001:2022-compliant, ISO 9001:2015-compliant, TPES DESE ISMS accredited and annual third-party CREST-accredited penetration testing. No public SOC 2 Type II evidence located.

ai.finding: Product page describes AI short-answer marking, question generation and learner support chatbot Alex; model provider, data routing, retention and training policy not established.

procurementChecks: Obtain current product-specific accessibility conformance report and confirm version/module scope.
Request current SOC 2 Type II / ISO certificates and verify legal entity, service boundary, audit period and exceptions.
Confirm production, backup, disaster-recovery, logs, telemetry, support and AI processing locations in contract/DPA.

researchTasks: Geographic availability needs an exact value: "Australia-focused, with international use subject to vendor support and regulatory fit".
Standards need exact versions: "SCORM-compliant content import is stated; confirm exact SCORM version and any xAPI/LTI support".
Pricing: record whether prices are public and the entry price.
Pricing model: confirm basis, free tier and trial. Workbook: "Subscription/quote; vendor directs prospects to request pricing".
Commercial relationship set to none; confirm before publication (affiliate programs in docs/affiliates.md).
